patterns.note: Content is consistently presented within a centered, fixed-width column, providing ample whitespace on the sides for a focused reading experience.
Major section headings use a very large, bold, and heavy sans-serif typeface to establish strong visual hierarchy and draw immediate attention.
A single vibrant blue is used exclusively for all interactive elements such as call-to-action buttons, links, and checkboxes, creating clear visual cues for user action.
No scroll-triggered motion; the design relies on static hierarchy and clear content presentation, with elements simply scrolling into and out of view.
The 'Form & Go Further' section presents a multi-part form-like interface with distinct steps and options, guiding the user through a complex process.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a standard vertical scrolling mechanism without any advanced scroll-triggered animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements; content simply moves up as the user scrolls down.

Visual hierarchy is strongly established through significant variations in font size and weight, with large, bold headings drawing attention to key sections, supported by lighter body text for details.

Interactive elements like buttons, links, and form fields are clearly distinguished using a vibrant accent blue against a predominantly white and light gray background, ensuring high contrast and discoverability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, and heavy sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by a clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels for details.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx. 4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card-like elements, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing, with ample whitespace around major sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel, while specific components like the pricing table have a denser, more structured layout.

standout: The site's standout feature is its clear, direct, and highly functional presentation of complex legal services. It demystifies legal paperwork for startups through a clean, almost form-like interface in its 'Form & Go Further' section, making a potentially intimidating process feel approachable and organized.
